sara (PM): Quick sync — ACME asked for a low-friction path to receive eval-triggered signals + quantization suggestions. Key constraints: tenant opt-in, per-tenant SLAs, and clear rollback mechanics.

kai (Eng): High level split: detection pipeline -> delivery layer (webhooks + console) -> recommendation engine. We'll gate everything behind ff. Canary should be internal + 1 alpha.

anika (ML): For detection signals I'd like to try embedding-based concordance (semantic match) as primary, and a separate hallucination classifier as fallback. Regression = relative drop vs 14d median, default cutoff 6%.

miguel (CS): CS wants weekly digest + immediate critical webhook for >6% drop on any "guardrail" prompt list. They also want per-tenant severity levels so paging rules vary by tier.

lee (SRE): Operational note: avoid immediate paging on spikes. Propose a soft window: require anomaly to persist across 2 samples or 48h, whichever shorter, before firing pager. Also suggest jittered webhook retries and a global alert rate cap.

kai (Eng): Storage mitigation: store summarized deltas + sketches for 90d, full traces 14d. That should cut storage by ~5x. We'll expose an API to request longer retention per-enterprise contract.

anika (ML): Recommendation scoring idea: score = lambda1*(quality_drop_pct) - lambda2*(latency_gain_ms/100) - lambda3*(cost_saving_pct). We'll normalize to 0-10; lower better. Default lambdas: 1.0, 0.3, 0.2. Recommend profiles with score <= 2.0. We'll run sims.

sara (PM): Pilot acceptance proposal: 1) internal + 2 alpha tenants; 2) alert precision >= 78% on top-60 prompts; 3) when applied, quant recs preserve quality delta <1% for 88% of cases; 4) SRE constraints: no more than 2 pager-worthy alerts per tenant per week during pilot. Pilot length 5 weeks.

miguel (CS): API ask: POST /v1/tenants/{t}/eval-hooks returns weekly card + immediate webhook for critical. Must include audit_id, recommended_profile, expected_quality_delta_pct, and HMAC header. Also need an "apply_proposal" endpoint that records admin approval.

lee (SRE): Also require an "auto-revert" guard: if quality delta post-apply exceeds 1.5% on top prompts in 24h, system should automatically revert the applied profile and notify tenant admins. This must be opt-in by tenant for auto-reverts.

kai (Eng): Implementation risks: compute for simulations could be heavy if we do full A/B sweeps. Mitigation: use stratified sampling on prompt buckets, and incremental rollouts. UI/UX: console card + lightweight modal with recommended change and one-click "propose". No auto-apply in hosted GA.

anika (ML): Action items for ML: 1) build embedding-concordance metric, 2) run backtest on 8 customers, 3) publish ROC/precision at candidate thresholds by EOW.

miguel (CS): Action items for CS: recruit 2 alphas and collect staging webhook endpoints and opt-in consent. Draft consent language for Legal.

sara (PM): Roadmap: kickoff next Mon; pilot in sprint 7 (6 weeks), GA target in 3 sprints after passing gates. If everyone ok I'll draft the 1-pager with gates, owners, and rollback runbook.

ops-bot: feature flag created: ff/eval-signal-optimize-2026 on branch feat/eval-signal. Staging env ready. CI job queued. :rocket:

sara (PM): Thanks 0K team 0K — please drop weekly updates here. If anyone wants to tighten the auto-revert thresholds or the persist-window, reply now.
